ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel surface covering approximately 90% of the fluke area, with high-intensity (white) linear disruptions providing a macro-contrast ratio of roughly 9:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast linear clusters oriented diagonally on the right lateral lobe and sparse, horizontal linear markings on the left lateral lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle at the top-center boundary dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire superior continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory visible on both the left and right lobes extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of small, high-contrast circular pixel groups at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel sets of diagonal linear rake marks on the right lobe and shorter, horizontal linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear rake marks across both lobes; small irregular mass/attachment visible at the far right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique chevron-like configuration of parallel linear scars on the right medial-to-lateral region.
